title: Stamp book
intro: A hanko stamp for every milestone of your daily bridges.
more: And {{ count }} more new stamps, see your stamp book.
pick: Tap one you've earned to show it next to your name on the leaderboards.
shown: {{ name }} now shows next to your name on the leaderboards.
hidden: No stamp next to your name any more.

texts.bridges_1000: Build 1,000 bridges in your dailies, a double bridge counts twice.
texts.streak_7: Solve the daily 7 days in a row.
texts.streak_30: Solve the daily 30 days in a row.
texts.streak_100: Solve the daily 100 days in a row.
texts.full_week: Solve every daily of one week, Monday's easy one to Sunday's oni.
texts.full_moon: Solve every daily of one calendar month.
texts.four_seasons: Solve a daily in winter, spring, summer and autumn.
texts.clean: Solve 10 dailies without hints or checks.
texts.stone_bridge: Solve a daily without ever taking a bridge away: no undo, no restart, no hints or checks.
texts.phoenix: Clear the board, start over, and still finish in the top three.
texts.tortoise: Finish a daily after more than an hour on the clock. Slow and steady!
texts.metronome: Solve three dailies of the same difficulty within 3% of each other's time.
texts.early_bird: Be the first to finish a daily.
texts.zero_hour: Start a daily within its first minute.
texts.on_the_brink: Finish a daily in its last 10 minutes.
texts.night_owl: Finish a daily between midnight and 4 a.m. your time.
texts.lunch_break: Finish a daily between noon and 2 p.m. your time.
texts.swift: Finish among the fastest tenth of a daily with at least 10 players.
texts.podium: Finish a daily in the top three.
texts.rainbow: Finish in the top three on every day of the week, Monday to Sunday.
texts.photo_finish: Finish within half a second of the player just above or below you.
texts.gold: Be the fastest of a daily.
texts.hat_trick: Be the fastest three days in a row.
texts.champion: Finish a month first in the monthly race.
texts.new_year: Solve the daily on the 1st of January.
texts.tanabata: Solve the daily on the 7th of July, when magpies build a bridge across the Milky Way.
texts.anniversary: Solve a daily on the day you joined, a year or more later.
texts.dojo: Get a SAT solver of yours onto the Dojo leaderboard.
texts.black_belt: Get a SAT solver of yours into the top three of the Dojo leaderboard.
texts.sensei: Top the Dojo leaderboard with a SAT solver of yours.
texts.second_thoughts: Take the same bridge away 10 times in one daily.
texts.palindrome: Finish with a time that reads the same backwards, like 1:22.1 or 12:21.
texts.lanterne_rouge: Finish last of a daily with at least 20 players. Somebody has to carry the lantern!
texts.leap_day: Solve the daily on the 29th of February.
texts.yokozuna: Top a group's weekly banzuke, in a week with at least three players.
texts.sansho: Win one of a group's weekly awards, in a week with at least three players.
texts.river_crew: Help your group across its river: lay planks of a level it completes.

secret.name: Secret stamp
secret.text: A secret stamp. Keep playing to find it!
